description: The plot shows how loss ratio (percent) varies with computational power (TFLOPs) for five methods. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and uses a custom, non-uniform numeric scale with labeled ticks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8, spanning from 1e7 to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale from 94 to 100 with tick marks every 1 unit. The purple solid line with triangle markers (“Vanilla”) is flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. The orange solid line with plus markers (“SepLLM (n=64)”) starts near 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 100.0% by 2e8, reaches a local high around 100.4% at 4e8, and ends near 99.9% at 9e8. The blue solid line with x markers (“SepLLM (n=128)”) begins around 97.0% at 1e7, increases to about 99.8% by 2e8, stays close to 100% through mid-range TFLOPs, and finishes near 99.8% at 9e8. The green solid line with diamond markers (“SepLLM (n=64, H)”) starts around 97.5% at 1e7, climbs to about 99.9–100.0% by 4e8–5e8, shows a small peak near 100.2% at 6e8, and ends around 99.9% at 9e8. The red solid line with circle markers (“SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”) starts at about 94.0% at 1e7, rises to roughly 97.2% at 5e7 and about 99.1% at 4e8, dips to around 98.5% at 5e8, returns near 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends around 98.7% at 9e8; the legend appears in the lower-right of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)' and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', starting at about 97% and ending at 99%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at around 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
